_meta.purpose: Labeled scoring eval dataset for the SCORING_V2 redesign (T7/T8). Each case is a (request, result) pair with the suitability verdict the scorer should reach under SCORING_V2=1. The anchor is the Goulds 3196 seal-vs-pump case. Fix the scorer, never relabel a case to pass.

request.part_number: string (UNKNOWN-PN placeholder when the part's own PN is unknown)

result.snippet: string (page text the scorer sees)
result.title: string (optional title hint)
result.found_pn: string | null (the vendor's extracted PN; null when none)

expected.rationale: string (why this verdict is correct)

_meta.note: should_pass_floor is the floor-clearance verdict under SCORING_V2=1 (TypeGate + graded Fit + Stage 0 placeholder fix). Clean-PN cases that pass flag-off must ALSO pass flag-on (no regression). Wrong-part-marketplace cases that pass flag-off (authority bias) must FAIL flag-on (the TypeGate fix).

result.snippet: Crane D100 gate valve, 2 inch, 150# class. In stock. Authorized distributor.
result.title: Crane D100 Gate Valve

expected.rationale: Wrong valve TYPE (gate on a ball-valve request) — but both classify to VALVE noun-class, so the TypeGate is SAME-class. This tests whether same-class-wrong-subtype still fails. Expected FAIL because the brief's gate is noun-class-level only (gate valve vs ball valve both = VALVE); this case documents a known gap (sub-type gating is Stage 3, out of scope). SHOULD FAIL the floor via weak Fit/no exact PN — but flag if it passes (would indicate over-credit). Marked should_pass_floor=false as the desired verdict; see T8 notes.
